_doc: Map 4 'Fernflug' Act IV: Mondlicht, the relay station (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md §6, DECISIONS T-112/T-113). map_key: the story-prop / intel key. act: the act block (RoundManager: rounds are ACT IV · n from match round start_round = 30, named here so the act numbers right whatever is built before it; gravity_scale / slide_distance_mult / vacuum are the map-wide physics GameState.apply_act_physics reads; the boss is summoned when its zone opens, not on a round; the renewal fallback renews the plan at act round renewal_fallback_act_round if the Account was never opened). zones: vacuum = no air (the AIR gauge); roam = open ground. earth: the sky object. solar_flare: the special round. columns: the three retention columns and the sign. renewal: the bad ending's clock. endings: the runners' timings. No exfil: this act ends the campaign (cancel_ending / renewal_ending).
roster_doc: jumpjockey and backorder are Act III's types (the Groom Lake build defines them in enemies.json; this act lists them by id: enemies.json `maps` admits them here, max_active 4 / 3). suited and shield_cell are this act's.

spawn_table._doc: windows = the domes' service hatches (closets outside the hull); ground = emerge points (the regolith, the conveyor, the nave's floor); catwalk = the leap points (Catwalk_C_YARD_n, and the hall's Catwalk_E_HALL_n since UPDATE 10 / T-158): the Moon's leapers (MoonLowG) rise there and come down at you from above. The Account has no spawns: the horde comes through its one door and the Manager brings the crew through the pad.

earth._doc_look: U09 s5 (T-149): the Earth hangs high over the north rim, not straight up, so it is in the yard's eye line; sun_dir points toward the Sun (the scene's Moon light is the Sun: low over the east rim, long shadows) and lights the Earth's day side.
earth._doc_reverse: UPDATE 10 §3 (T-158): the Earthrise beats. The violet spread grows with the act's rounds and REVERSES as the Kuendigung's cancel steps complete: each completed step of reverse_steps (in reverse_quest) takes 1/n of the spread away (EarthSky.reversed_spread); all of them (s18_cancel is CANCEL) turn the night side dark_blue. vo_dim: by the number of steps done, the Operator and Wren notice (two lines each); vo_spread: by act round, a line as the violet grows.

solar_flare._doc: The special round: the air posts fail, the Earth flickers, the Suited come over the rim every interval_seconds in waves of per_wave while the queue lasts; the yard shut: Gängers through the fallback points of the open domes. The last wave's point takes the Resupply.

columns._doc: The three retention columns in the hall (RetentionColumn): read the terms plate (hold read_seconds; a Lodestone lift on the cap sets cap_lifted_N and the hold is lifted_read_seconds), the cap lifts, the lattice goes dark, a letter falls off NOBODY CANCELS, the Backorders wake. All three dark: flag account_open (the Account door). panels: which fine-print panel each plate quotes (the TERMS_READ_N category reads it aloud).

stages: N B D  C N  LS

renewal._doc: The bad ending's clock (renewal_ending.gd): starts at the Manager's RENEWAL phase, real seconds; warn_at are the Operator's warnings (seconds left); the plan also renews on its own at the act's renewal_fallback_act_round if the Account was never opened. The key turning (the cancel ending) stops it.

arrival._doc: What the Act III flags change on arrival: peg_delivered = no arrival grace and -20% Scrip (the program's men have the manifest); dee_cage_done = Dee's three fading radio lines over the first rounds.

terminator._doc: UPDATE 10 §3 (T-158, contract C6 `terminator`): the day/night line. A vertical plane with its flat normal toward the Sun stands at center + h*s; s runs from from_s (all day) at act round 1 to to_s (all night) at the act's last round, gliding glide_seconds after each round start (host-owned, mirrored). The Sun's azimuth turns sun_azimuth_deg over the act and its elevation sinks from sun_elev_from to sun_elev_to; a shadow-only wall (wall_height x wall_length) on the line casts the night. Night side: in vacuum the suit heater strains (cold_air_drain s of air per s, x heater_cold_mult once the heaters run), the domes' lights drop to zone_dim, the zone's spawns get shadow_spawn_mult (+1 pressure). Day side of the yard: glare unless the visor is down (glare_from_dot: how far toward the Sun you must face; glare_max). economy_dim: the domes' lights before the heaters. zone_centres: where each zone counts as crossed. vo_cross: the Operator, once per zone crossed (in turn). vo_glare: once, on the first glare.

heaters._doc: UPDATE 10 §3 (T-158, the Bar's row 9): the relay heaters' breaker (HeaterSwitch) on the concourse's north wall by the yard airlock: a free hold; the domes' lights come up in dome_order every dome_gap s, the mast surges, the airlocks cycle, the perks wake, burst Gangers at burst_points after burst_after s, the Operator (vo). Sets flag heaters_on.

low_g._doc: UPDATE 10 §3 (T-158, contract C6 `low_g`): JumpPad plates (pads: name, at, to = the landing spot, flight_s = the arc's time in the air under the act's gravity, zone); the yard's crater (crater: centre, rim radius, rim height, the gaps' bearings in degrees and width) is crossed by pad YardPad_S -> its north rim and back by YardPad_N; the leapers: Gangers that rise at a Catwalk_* point leap at a chasing target leap_min_m..leap_max_m away in a high slow arc (air_seconds under the zombies' Moon gravity, cooldown); shot in the air they fall and die; a landing staggers players within land_radius. The fling into space: a Lodestone fling in a vacuum zone whose speed (m/s) is at least fling_speed sends the zombie up and out (a kill credited to the flinger plus orbit_scrip, a fading scream, a streak): the HUD counts SENT TO ORBIT.

meteor_shower._doc: UPDATE 10 §3 (T-158, contract C6 `meteor_shower`; the Bar's row 14 with the shaft grate): a round event on match rounds first_round, first_round + every, ... (never on a special round). The relay warns warn_seconds ahead (klaxon, the Operator's 'scheduled maintenance', a banner), then for seconds the yard (yard_box [x0, z0, x1, z1]) takes impacts_per_s small impacts: each a falling streak (fall_s) and a strike radius_m wide (zombies die, players take player_damage at the centre, falling off to the edge), a crater mark that fades after mark_seconds, dust. Every aim_every-th impact lands within aim_m of a player standing in the yard, telegraphed by a ring tele_s ahead. Shelter in the modules: nothing lands under a roof. Host-owned: the host picks every point and mirrors it.

shaft_grate._doc: UPDATE 10 §3 (T-158, the Bar's row 14): the Account's floor vent over the dish's vacuum shaft, just inside the Account's one door (where the horde comes in). A lever (cost, like the other traps) opens the grate for open_seconds: zombies on it (radius_m) are drawn down the shaft (a kill with a long fall and the vent's roar), and a zombie the Lodestone flings onto the open grate drops too; players on it are thrown clear (push_mps) and take player_damage. cooldown s.
